currentAffairs.point: The COP31 summit highlighted the ongoing debate regarding financial contributions from developed countries towards mitigating global carbon emissions.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This reflects a critical negotiation point in international climate agreements and India’s concerns about equitable burden-sharing.

currentAffairs.point: Pope Francis revealed in his personal diary that he had witnessed three apparitions of the devil during his time as Pope.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This news highlights a potentially sensitive and geopolitically relevant development concerning the Vatican’s leadership and its relationship with religious beliefs.

currentAffairs.point: Exporters are seeking waivers of detention and demurrage charges due to the boycott of trailer crew scanning at Cochin Port’s Vallarpadam terminal.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This directly impacts trade flows and port operations – a significant area for economic analysis.

currentAffairs.point: Household fuel usage (wood, dung) is the primary cause of elevated air pollution levels on Delhi's outskirts.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: The study’s findings challenge conventional assumptions about crop burning as the sole source of rural pollution and necessitate a shift in environmental policy.

currentAffairs.point: Union Home Minister Amit Shah, along with other senior BJP leaders, will address a joint press conference regarding the ongoing Punjab Assembly polls.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This indicates heightened strategic engagement by the ruling party in a crucial state election.

currentAffairs.point: The International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruling emphasizes the necessity of democracy in Myanmar as a prerequisite for Rohingya refugees' return.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This reflects ongoing geopolitical tensions and India’s role in advocating for human rights within the South Asian region.

currentAffairs.point: The Petroleum Ministry indicates an anticipated pick-up in oil and gas production within the next 4-5 years due to recently implemented measures.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This reflects a significant shift in industry outlook and provides context for ongoing investment decisions related to India’s energy sector.

currentAffairs.point: Negotiations between India and the EU have concluded on a free trade pact expected to be signed in December.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This reflects evolving global trade dynamics and potential impacts on Indian exports and investment.

currentAffairs.point: India's oil and gas sectors experienced minimal growth despite a low base effect.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This indicates underlying structural issues within the sector that require government attention and policy intervention.

currentAffairs.point: India has officially removed Israel from its list of ‘walkover’ nations, reflecting a deepening security partnership.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This marks a notable change in India's established diplomatic approach to the Middle East.

currentAffairs.point: SBI, HDFC Bank, and ICICI Bank have retained their Designated Significant Institution (D-SIB) status following RBI’s capital requirements review.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This reflects ongoing efforts to bolster the resilience of India's largest banks amidst evolving economic conditions.

currentAffairs.point: Doodhvale, a New Delhi-based dairy firm, is planning to expand its operations into western and central India.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: The company’s intention to explore international markets via North America reflects broader trends in Indian food exports and the growth of domestic agricultural value chains.

currentAffairs.point: Researchers in Kerala have identified a connection between the regular use of fairness creams and nephrotic syndrome among patients.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This highlights a previously unreported health risk associated with cosmetic products and raises questions about product safety regulations.

currentAffairs.point: India has initiated mapping of landslide susceptibility across 4.3 lakh square kilometers as part of a shift towards proactive landslide management strategies.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: The initiative reflects a move from post-disaster relief to preventative measures, aligning with national priorities for resilience and sustainable development.

currentAffairs.point: The Green India Mission requires adequate resources and robust monitoring mechanisms for effective climate action.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This emphasizes the operational challenges in achieving ambitious environmental goals.

history.point: The government of Colombia and the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia–People's Army sign a revised peace deal, bringing an end to the country's more than 50-year-long civil war.

A Russian Air Force Sukhoi Su-24 fighter jet is shot down by the Turkish Air Force over the Syria–Turkey border, killing one of the two pilots; a Russian marine is also killed during a subsequent rescue effort.
Iran signs an interim agreement with the P5+1 countries, limiting its nuclear program in exchange for reduced sanctions.
Space Shuttle program: Atlantis launches on STS-44.

Joseph-Désiré Mobutu seizes power in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and becomes President; he rules the country (which he renames Zaire in 1971) for over 30 years, until being overthrown by rebels in 1997.
The Senegalese Socialist Party holds its second congress.

The Finnish far-right Lapua Movement officially begins when a group of mainly the former White Guard members, led by Vihtori Kosola, interrupted communism occasion at the Workers' House in Lapua, Finland.
The Texas Provincial Government authorizes the creation of a horse-mounted police force called the Texas Rangers (which is now the Texas Ranger Division of the Texas Department of Public Safety).
Peter I of Cyprus ascends the throne of Cyprus after his father, Hugh IV of Cyprus, abdicates.
Conrad of Montferrat becomes King of Jerusalem upon his marriage to Isabella I of Jerusalem.

revision: India's oil and gas sectors experienced minimal growth despite a low base effect.
Prime Minister Balen Shah of Nepal is undertaking a bilateral visit to India with an agenda centered around energy cooperation and establishing connectivity links.
The Singhanias are repurposing industrial land for hospitality and real estate projects, raising questions about urban planning regulations and land use policies.
India is seeking to deepen economic ties with Finland through cooperation on the startup sector.
JNPA has awarded an 8-year contract to Gateway Distriparks for rail yard operations at the DFC facility.
There has been an increase in the number of cyclones forming in the Bay of Bengal over the past few decades, particularly since 2001.
